stem:
The graph of an exponential function is shown on the grid.

Based on the graph, which statement about the function is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The range is the set of all real numbers less than 0.

options.label: B
options.text: The domain is the set of all real numbers greater than -4.

options.label: C
options.text: The range is the set of all real numbers greater than 0.

options.label: D
options.text: The domain is the set of all real numbers less than -4.

visual_elements: graph of an exponential function with x-axis labeled from -10 to 10 and y-axis labeled from -10 to 10, curve shown decreasing from left to right staying above the x-axis
